title: The Last Summer Again
author: Jude Joubert
blurb: Lena Dravenmoor, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the bakery lease runs out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
